Analysis: Both hypotheses explore the dual role of COL1A2-driven ECM remodeling and mRNA export dysregulation in liver neoplasms. However, Hypothesis 2 exhibits greater specificity by identifying particular mRNA export regulators (NUP62 and NXF1) and suggesting potential signaling intermediates such as integrin and FAK pathways. This detailed mechanism enhances its plausibility and provides clearer experimental targets, thereby increasing testability. Safety considerations are similar between the two, but the improved clarity and specificity of Hypothesis 2 make it a more robust and actionable proposal.
